description: Which countries' UK travel advice changed most recently, and what changed? Lists FCDO travel advice pages newest first, with the time of each update and the FCDO's own one-line summary of the change. Live from the GOV.UK Content API, for travel managers, agents and journalists. Shows only the latest change per country; use travel_advice_country for a country's earlier changes. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, how many countries to list, 1-100, default 20

name: travel_advice_recent_updates
